annotations.title: Start an app from a template

description: Use this when the user picks one of Xenition's app templates (from find_app_templates) and wants their own working copy. Copies the full template into their Xenition workspace and publishes it to a live URL; publishing takes a few minutes and app_status reports the links. To generate a new app from a description instead, use build_app.

name.description: optional name for the user's copy; defaults to the template's name

templateId.description: the template id from find_app_templates, e.g. 'tpl-danceschool'

name: build_app_from_template
title: Start an app from a template
